notes: Public source materials expose aggregate status and process information, but do not provide a complete named customer queue.
Values sourced from ERCOT's June 19 2026 LLWG Report (Large Load Interconnection Status Update), data as of June 18, 2026, reviewed from the official PPTX on July 15, 2026.

This snapshot captures queue state adjacent to the PUCT's June 18, 2026 approval of the Batch Zero interconnection framework (PGRR145/NPRR1325, effective July 11, 2026), which ended the prior Planning Guide Section 9 process on July 10, 2026.
Month-over-month, the total queue fell 4,918 MW from May (471,415 MW) to June (466,497 MW) due to cancelled or duplicate ticket removal and stage consolidation (report slide 2), not declining demand.

Operator review: the June 2026 LLWG payload stored in data/processed/load/large_load_refresh_candidate.json was approved for the public summary on 2026-08-07 (Matt Prusak, via agent). This tracker was reconciled to the same snapshot the chartbook funnel already published.
Named or customer-specific load-study rows should be treated as private candidates until a public filing source is captured and reviewed.
